The citations also do not fit the points they support.","problems":["Leaning 'pattern_consistent_with_upcoding' contradicts tool output, which was undecided (leaning null, no decision yet); the summary does not acknowledge the override.","Unsupported claim: 'The chart support may be inflated to match the bill, so it counts for little' is speculation that discredits the charts without evidence; the charts were complete, random, and had no deficiencies.","References 'It is weaker than for 033', another provider not in this packet; this is a stray cross-case reference that is not grounded here.","States 'I made no overpayment estimate because charts rarely showed a lower level' - no estimate tool output is shown, so this is not grounded in the packet and is awkward.","Headline says 'Notes describe data review that the claims don't show' without caveat, and the 7 of 25 figure is based on lab lines on the claim, which is weak evidence for overstated data review.","Cited claim C0035831 is the one below-billed example, but the other cited claims (C0035757, C0035769, C0035773) are only low-complexity examples, with no documented support or non-support, so the citation set is thin; the 'often for back pain, URI, rash' mention includes rash, which is not in the listed dx codes.","Next step about copied-forward notes is generic; 'most 99215 notes have no time recorded' is not clearly supported by the card (only 4 examples shown, 1 with minutes).","Redundant and repeated text (47.6% and 48% stated twice; charts finding stated twice) makes it harder to read."]}
